notes: μή here is an ordinary negative and is aligned to 'not', rule 44's unrepresented arm reaching only the interrogative particle.
ἁψάμενος is converted to a coordinate finite clause and the following juncture is placed on εἶπεν, the verb it introduces (rule 88).
προσῆλθεν takes only 'came': the ASV writes no separate particle for the preverb προσ- and no dative complement stands (rule 106).
